To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the system operation strategy and energy management method are proposed to achieve high penetration depth application for a renewable energy-based dc Micro-Grid.

the proposed operation strategy and energy management method can be used to control the dc micro-grid to operate in both grid-connected and islanding mode with high penetration level of renewable sources and the proposed method can also be used for other types of micro-grid with different structure.
a renewable energy-based dc grid with hybrid energy storage consisting of battery and ultra-capacitor, is proposed to achieve high penetration of renewable energy into utility grid.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the system operation and energy management of renewable energy-based dc grids for high penetration depth application.
the design and implementation of a dc micro-grid with high penetration depth.

the system operation and energy management issues of a renewable energy-based dc-micro-grid with hybrid energy storages, which can be considered as a new approach to achieve high penetration depth application of renewable energy sources into the utility grids.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed system operation and energy management method can achieve high penetration depth and high power quality in the micro-grid system.
the proposed system operation and energy management methods can be used to achieve high penetration depth for a renewable energy-based dc grid.
the proposed system operation and energy management method can effectively control the power flow of the micro-grid and improve the system reliability.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed strategy and method are capable of achieving a high penetration depth of the renewable energy into the utility grid with a simple and reliable system operation.

the proposed system operation method is suitable for high penetration depth application and the proposed energy management method could be used to control a renewable energy-based dc system with high penetration depth of the renewable energy sources.
the system operation strategy and energy management method proposed in this paper could be a good candidate to achieve high penetration depth application of micro-grids.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the proposed system operation and energy management methods are able to support the micro-grid to operate in both connected and isolated mode, while the power dispatching of the power system is not affected by the micro-grid.
a dc micro-grid can be designed to deliver/absorbs predefined amount of power from/to the utility grid during the connected mode and zero in islanding mode.
, the proposed system operation and energy management method will certainly simplify the micro-grid control system and increase the penetration depth of renewable micro-grid into the utility grid.
